import sys,json,os
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
audit=Path(sys.argv[1]).open('x')
def record(value):
    audit.write(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True)+'\n'); audit.flush()
class NoNative:
    def find_spec(self,fullname,path=None,target=None):
        if fullname.split('.')[0] in ('cvc5','z3'):
            record({'blocked_native_import':fullname})
            raise RuntimeError('native solver import forbidden in mocked integration qualification')
sys.meta_path.insert(0,NoNative())
logger="import os; from explicit_phase_worker import phase; phase('test.before'); os._exit(17)"
def hook(event,args):
    if event=='subprocess.Popen':
        argv=args[1]
        isgit=(argv==['/usr/bin/git','-C',str(Path.cwd()/'research/ocm-prototype'),'rev-parse','HEAD'] or argv==['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
        islogger=argv==[sys.executable,'-B','-c',logger]
        record({'event':event,'argv':argv,'cwd':str(args[2]),'classification':'git_lineage' if isgit else 'phase_log_flush' if islogger else 'FORBIDDEN'})
        if not (isgit or islogger): raise RuntimeError('unregistered child process forbidden')
    elif event in ('os.system','os.posix_spawn','os.spawn'):
        record({'blocked_process_event':event}); raise RuntimeError('native dispatch forbidden')
sys.addaudithook(hook)
status=pytest.main(sys.argv[2:])
record({'pytest_exit_code':status,'native_assay_executions':0,'native_checker_executions':0})
audit.close()
raise SystemExit(status)
